headline: Walmart Shares Slide on Cautious Profit Outlook Despite Strong Q4 Earnings
body: Walmart shares fell 1.38% to $124.87 after the retail giant forecast 2026 earnings of $2.75-$2.85 per share, below Wall Street expectations. The world's largest retailer reported strong Q4 revenue and robust e-commerce growth, but investors reacted negatively to the cautious full-year guidance. Walmart also announced a $30 billion buyback program and named John Furner as its new CEO. The mixed results reflect ongoing consumer uncertainty despite the company's digital transformation success.

headline: Etsy Soars 22% After Selling Depop to eBay for $1.2 Billion
body: Etsy shares surged 22% in premarket trading and closed up 21.2% at $49.01 after announcing it would sell its Depop secondhand clothing platform to eBay for $1.2 billion in cash. The deal, expected to close in Q2 2026, allows Etsy to focus on its core marketplace while raising significant capital. The move comes alongside a Q4 earnings beat, with the company demonstrating strong profitability despite recent market challenges.
source: Yahoo Finance, MarketWatch, The Motley Fool

headline: Deere Stock Jumps 11.6% on Earnings Beat and Raised Guidance
body: Deere & Company shares rose 11.6% after the farm machinery maker reported Q1 earnings of $656 million and raised its full-year net income guidance to $4.5-$5.0 billion. The company cited a recovery in construction and small agriculture segments, with 2026 net sales now forecast to be up around 15%. Deere's strong performance reflects improving demand in key markets despite ongoing global agricultural challenges.
source: Reuters, Yahoo Finance, Deere Press Release

headline: Madison Square Garden Sports Surges 13% on Knicks-Rangers Spinoff Plan
body: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. shares jumped 13% to a record high after the company announced plans to spin off its New York Knicks NBA franchise from its New York Rangers NHL team. The board unanimously approved the split, which would create two separately traded public companies. While no timeline was provided for the final decision, investors responded positively to the potential value unlock from separating the two major sports franchises.

headline: Occidental Petroleum Rises on Earnings Beat and Oil Price Rally
body: Occidental Petroleum shares gained 8.61% after beating fourth quarter earnings expectations and benefiting from oil prices climbing to six-month highs. West Texas Intermediate futures rose about 2% to $66.55 per barrel amid growing concerns over potential U.S. military action against Iran. The oil price rally provided additional support for energy stocks despite broader market weakness.
